title: El Salvador’s Bukele touts military intervention in Haiti
english: El Salvador’s President Nayib Bukele has deployed over 2,000 troops to Haiti to help combat local gangs following the disappearance of four Salvadoran technicians. While Bukele claims his forces are effectively confronting criminal groups, their presence has raised concerns regarding the official command structure and authority of the intervention. Meanwhile, Haitian authorities recently located the burned vehicle of the missing technicians in a gang-controlled area, though the men remain missing.
amharic: የኤል ሳልቫዶር ፕሬዝዳንት ናይብ ቡኬሌ አራት የሀገራቸው ቴክኒሻኖች ከጠፉ በኋላ በአይቲ የሚንቀሳቀሱ የወንበዴ ቡድኖችን ለመዋጋት ከሁለት ሺህ በላይ ወታደሮችን ወደ ሀገሪቱ ልከዋል። ቡኬሌ ወታደሮቹ የወንጀል ቡድኖችን በመቆጣጠር ረገድ ውጤታማ እንደሆኑ ቢናገሩም፣ የዚህ ወታደራዊ ጣልቃ ገብነት የአመራር አወቃቀር እና ህጋዊ ስልጣን ጥያቄ አስነስቷል። በሌላ በኩል የሀይቲ ባለስልጣናት በወንበዴዎች ቁጥጥር ስር በነበረ አካባቢ የጠፉት ቴክኒሻኖች ይጠቀሙበት የነበረውን የተቃጠለ ተሽከርካሪ ያገኙ ሲሆን፣ ግለሰቦቹ እስካሁን አልተገኙም።
oromo: Pireezidaantii El Salvaadoor Naayib Buukeelen, ogeeyyiin teknishinii biyyasaanii afur erga badanii booda garee yakkaarraa Haayitii ittisuuf waraana 2,000 ol gara achitti ergeera. Buukeelen waraanni isaa garee yakkaarratti tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachaa jiraachuu kan ibse ta'us, humni kun eenyuun akka ajajamuufi seerummaan isaa gaaffii keessa galeera. Gama biraatiin, aangoyyoonni Haayitii konkolaataa ogeeyyota badanii kanneenii kan ta'e kan gubate bakka garee yakkootiin to'atamu tokkotti argataniiru; namoonni kunneen garuu hanga ammaa hin argamne.

title: Election deniers lose races for governor in key US swing states
english: Several Republican candidates who questioned the validity of the 2020 US presidential election were defeated in key gubernatorial races during the recent midterm elections. These individuals had either voted to challenge the previous election results or actively promoted claims of voter fraud. Their losses are significant because state governors play a major role in overseeing election procedures ahead of the upcoming 2028 presidential contest.
amharic: የ2020 የአሜሪካ ፕሬዝዳንታዊ ምርጫ ውጤትን በጥርጣሬ ሲመለከቱ የነበሩ በርካታ የሪፐብሊካን እጩዎች በቅርቡ በተካሄደው የአጋማሽ ዘመን ምርጫ በገዢነት ውድድር ተሸንፈዋል። እነዚህ ግለሰቦች ቀደም ሲል የተደረገውን ምርጫ ውጤት በመቃወም ድምጽ የሰጡ ወይም የምርጫ ማጭበርበር ተፈጽሟል በማለት ሲከራከሩ የነበሩ ናቸው። የነዚህ እጩዎች መሸነፍ በ2028 ለሚካሄደው ፕሬዝዳንታዊ ምርጫ የምርጫ ሂደቱን በመቆጣጠር ረገድ የክልል ገዢዎች ከፍተኛ ሚና ስላላቸው ትልቅ ፋይዳ አለው።
oromo: Hirmaattota filannoo bara 2020 irratti gaaffii kaasaa turan kaadhimamtoonni paartii Riippaabilikaanii shan filannoo gidduu waggaa kanaan gaggeeffame irratti injifatamaniiru. Namoonni kunneen bu'aa filannoo darbee mormuun sagalee kennanii fi yakka filannoo raawwatameera jechuun olola oofaa turan. Injifannoo dhabuun namoota kanaa filannoo pirezidaantummaa bara 2028 dura adeemsa filannoo to'achuuf gaheen hoogganoota naannolee olaanaa waan ta'eef hiika guddaa qaba.

title: Israel’s Herzog accepts vote results, opens talks on forming a government
english: Israeli President Isaac Herzog has officially accepted the recent election results, initiating discussions with party leaders to determine who will lead the next government. This move undermines Benjamin Netanyahu's attempts to challenge the legitimacy of the vote, in which his coalition failed to secure a parliamentary majority. Opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot is currently seeking support from various factions, including Arab-led parties, to reach the necessary threshold to form a new administration.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ፕሬዝዳንት ይስሐቅ ሄርዞግ የቅርብ ጊዜውን የምርጫ ውጤት በይፋ በመቀበል፣ ቀጣዩን መንግስት ማን እንደሚመራ ለመወሰን ከፓርቲ መሪዎች ጋር ውይይት ጀምረዋል። ይህ እርምጃ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ የምርጫውን ውጤት ለመሻር ያደረጉትን ጥረት የሚያዳክም ነው። የተቃዋሚው መሪ ጋዲ አይዘንኮት አዲስ መንግስት ለመመስረት የሚያስፈልገውን የፓርላማ ድጋፍ ለማግኘት ከአረብ ፓርቲዎች ጋር ጨምሮ ድርድር እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Israa'el Isaak Herzoog bu'aa filannoo dhumaa fudhachuun, mootummaa haaraa eenyu akka ijaaru marii gaggeessuu eegalaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun yaalii Binyaamiin Netaaniyaahuu bu'aa filannichaa mormuuf godhan kan laaffise yoo ta'u, kutaaleen isaa baay'ina teessoo waan dhabaniif aangoo qabatanii itti fufuun isaanitti ulfaateera. Hogganaan mormituu Gaadii Aayizankootti mootummaa haaraa ijaaruuf deeggarsa argachuuf paartilee adda addaa, keessattuu paartilee Arabaa waliin mari'achaa jiru.

title: Africa’s richest man launches mega oil tank farm in Namibia
english: Nigerian billionaire Aliko Dangote has officially opened a massive fuel storage facility in Walvis Bay, Namibia. This $2.5 billion investment is designed to secure and stabilize the supply of fuel throughout the Southern African region. The project represents a significant expansion of Dangote's growing portfolio of oil and energy businesses across the African continent.
amharic: የናይጄሪያው ቢሊየነር አሊኮ ዳንጎቴ በናሚቢያ ዋልቪስ ቤይ ግዙፍ የነዳጅ ማከማቻ ተቋም መርቀው ከፍተዋል። 2.5 ቢሊዮን ዶላር የሚገመትበት ይህ ፕሮጀክት በደቡባዊ አፍሪካ ቀጠና የነዳጅ አቅርቦትን አስተማማኝ ለማድረግ ያለመ ነው። ይህ ስራ የዳንጎቴ በዘይትና በኢነርጂ ዘርፍ በአህጉሪቱ እያከናወኑት ያለው የንግድ እንቅስቃሴ አካል ነው።
oromo: Abbaan qabeenyaa biyya Naayijeeriyaa Aliko Daangotee, buufata boba'aa guddaa biyya Naamiibiyaa magaala Walvis Bay keessatti ijaarame eebbisee baneera. Invastimantiin doolaara biiliyoona 2.5 kun, dhiyeessiin boba'aa naannoo Afrikaa kibbaa keessatti tasgabbaa'aa akka ta'uuf yaadamee kan ijaarame dha. Projeektiin kun hojiiwwan boba'aa fi anniisaa Daangotee guutuu Afrikaa keessatti babal'isaa jiran keessaa tokko dha.

title: Ohio’s voters tell Republicans: don’t take us for granted
english: Following recent election losses in Ohio, where Democrats secured both a Senate seat and the governorship, voters are sending a strong message to the Republican Party. The results indicate that the electorate no longer feels the state is a guaranteed win for Republicans. Citizens are urging party leadership to stop assuming their support and to pay closer attention to their concerns.
amharic: በኦሃዮ ግዛት ዲሞክራቶች ሴኔትን እና የአገረ ገዥነት ምርጫን በማሸነፋቸው፣ መራጮች ለሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲ ጠንካራ መልእክት አስተላልፈዋል። የቅርብ ጊዜ የምርጫ ውጤቶች እንደሚያሳዩት ድምጽ ሰጪዎች ግዛታቸው ለሪፐብሊካኖች በእርግጠኝነት የሚሰጥ መሆኑን መቀበል አቁመዋል። መራጮቹ የፓርቲው አመራሮች ድጋፋቸውን እንደ ቀላል ነገር እንዲመለከቱት እንደማይፈልጉ እና ለህዝብ ጥያቄዎች ትኩረት እንዲሰጡ እያሳሰቡ ነው።
oromo: Bu'aa filannoo Ohaayoo keessatti Demokiraatonni iddoo Senaataa fi aangoo bulchaa mootummaa argachuun isaanii, filattoonni paartii Riippabilikaanif ergaa cimaa dabarsaa jiraachuu argisiisa. Bu'aan kun akka agarsiisutti, filattoonni naannoo isaanii paartii Riippabilikaaniif guutummaatti amanamoo akka ta'an amanuu dhaabaniiru. Ummanni hoogganoota paartichaa deggarsa isaanii akka waan salphaatti akka hin ilaalle fi rakkoo isaaniif xiyyeeffannoo kennuu akka qaban dhaammachaa jiru.

title: Ukraine says bodycam video shows deadly Russian double-tap bombing
english: Ukrainian police released bodycam footage capturing a deadly Russian 'double-tap' airstrike in the village of Kamyshuvakha, which killed at least 40 people. The attack targeted residents gathering for humanitarian aid and then hit the shelter where they sought refuge. President Zelensky condemned the incident as a war crime, noting that search and rescue efforts are ongoing for many people still trapped under the debris.
amharic: የዩክሬን ፖሊስ በካሚሹቫካ መንደር ቢያንስ 40 ሰዎችን የገደለውን የሩሲያ ድርብ የአየር ጥቃት የሚያሳይ የሰውነት ካሜራ ምስል አውጥቷል። ጥቃቱ የሰብአዊ እርዳታ ለመቀበል በተሰበሰቡ ሰዎች ላይ ያነጣጠረ ሲሆን፣ በመቀጠልም የተረፉት የተጠለሉበትን መጠለያ መቷል። ፕሬዝዳንት ዘለንስኪ ጥቃቱን የጦር ወንጀል በማለት ያወገዙ ሲሆን፣ በአሁኑ ወቅትም በፍርስራሽ ስር የተቀበሩ ሰዎችን ለማውጣት ፍለጋ እየተደረገ መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Poolisiin Yukreen vidiyoo kaameeraa qaamaa isaanii irratti ka'e gadhiise, lola Raashiyaan baadiyaa Kaamishuvaakhaa keessatti namoota 40 ol ajjeese kan ibsu dha. Raashiyaan namoota gargaarsa namoomaa fudhachuuf walgahanii turanirratti erga miidhaa geessistee booda, namoonni miidhaman bakka qubatanitti lola lammaffaa banuun ishee beekameera. Pirezidaanti Zeleniskiin gocha kana yakka waraanaa jechuun balaaleffatan; yeroo ammas namoonni diigama jala jiran barbaadamaa jiru.

title: Palestinians, Israelis react after Democrats sweep US midterms
english: The Democratic Party's victory in the recent US midterm elections has sparked mixed reactions among Israelis and Palestinians. This shift in Congressional power is expected to significantly influence the direction of President Donald Trump’s administration over the next two years. Observers believe these results could lead to major changes in American foreign policy within the region.
amharic: በቅርቡ በተካሄደው የአሜሪካ መካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ የዲሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ ማሸነፍ በእስራኤላውያን እና በፍልስጤማውያን ዘንድ የተለያየ አስተያየቶችን ፈጥሯል። ይህ በኮንግረስ ውስጥ የተፈጠረው የሥልጣን ለውጥ በፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ አስተዳደር ቀጣይ ሁለት ዓመታት ፖሊሲዎች ላይ ትልቅ ተጽዕኖ ይኖረዋል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል። የፖለቲካ ተንታኞች ውጤቱ በአሜሪካ የውጭ ግንኙነት ፖሊሲ ላይ ለውጥ ሊያመጣ እንደሚችል ይገልጻሉ።
oromo: Bu'aan filannoo giddu galeessa Ameerikaa kutaalee Demokraatikoota harka gale kun, Israa'elootaafi Falasxiinota gidduutti yaada wal-hin fakkaanne uumeera. Jijjiiramni aangoo Kongiresii kun, waggoota lamaan dhufanitti akkaataa bulchiinsa Pireezidaant Doonald Traamp irratti dhiibbaa guddaa qabaata jedhamee eegama. Bu'aan kun immoo siyaasa alaa Ameerikaa naannichaa keessatti jijjiirama bu'uuraa fiduu danda'a jedhanii yaadu.

title: Social media reacts to Democrats’ takeover of US Congress
english: The Democratic Party has achieved significant victories in the recent US midterm elections, successfully gaining control of Congress. These results have sparked widespread online discussion, with notable figures like Donald Trump linking Republican losses to the conflict with Iran. Meanwhile, supporters are celebrating major milestones, such as Abdul El-Sayed’s historic win in the Senate.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የዲሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ በቅርቡ በተካሄደው የመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ ትልቅ ድል በመቀዳጀት የኮንግረስን ቁጥጥር በእጁ አስገብቷል። ይህ ውጤት በማህበራዊ ሚዲያዎች ላይ ከፍተኛ መነጋገሪያ ሆኗል፤ በተለይም ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የሪፐብሊካኖችን ሽንፈት ከኢራን ጦርነት ጋር በማያያዝ አስተያየታቸውን ሰጥተዋል። በሌላ በኩል ደጋፊዎች እንደ አብዱል ኤል-ሳየድ በሴኔት ምርጫ ያስመዘገቡትን ታሪካዊ ድል እያከበሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Paartiin Dimookraatik kan Ameerikaa filannoo giddu-galeessa biyyattii irratti injifannoo guddaa gonfachuun to'annoo Koongirasii fudhateera. Bu'aan kun miidiyaalee hawaasaa irratti haasaa guddaa uumeera; keessumaa Donald Trump injifannoo dhabuu Paartii Rippiiblikaanotaa waraana Iraan waliin walqabsiisaniiru. Gamtaan immoo, deggertoonni injifannoo seena qabeessa Abduul El-Saayid kan gara Senetii galan akkasumas milkaa'ina paartichaa kabajaa jiru.

title: Israel restricting treatment for 1,100 child amputees in Gaza: NGO
english: A human rights group reports that Israel is blocking travel and medical evacuations for over 1,100 children in Gaza who have suffered limb amputations. Due to limited local resources and a severe shortage of specialized professionals, these children are unable to receive the necessary prosthetics and long-term care they need. oromo: Markabni boba'aa fe'u tokko qarqara galaana Omaanitti wantoota hin beekamne lamaniin rukutameera. Aangeyyonni akka ibsanitti, hanga ammaatti namni miidhame ykn miidhaan naannoo irratti ga'e hin jiru. Sababa rukuttaa kanaa adda baasuuf qorannoon eegalameera.

title: Opinion: How an election defeat triggered a carnival of racism against Palestinians
english: The article discusses a personal experience in West Jerusalem shortly before the Israeli elections. The author recalls an encounter with young children who approached them to ask about their voting intentions. This observation serves as a starting point for the author to examine the broader political climate and the rising tensions regarding Palestinian citizens in Israel.
amharic: ጽሁፉ በእስራኤል ምርጫ ወቅት በምዕራብ እየሩሳሌም የገጠመውን አንድ ክስተት ይዳስሳል። ደራሲው በምርጫው ዋዜማ የድምጽ አሰጣጥ ሂደቱን በተመለከተ ትናንሽ ህጻናት ጥያቄ እንዳቀረቡለት ይገልጻል። ይህ አጋጣሚ በእስራኤል የሚኖሩ ፍልስጤማውያን ዜጎች ላይ እያደገ የመጣውን የፖለቲካ ውጥረት እና ዘረኝነት ለመተንተን እንደ መነሻ ያገለግላል።
oromo: Barruun kun filannoo Israa'el dura magaalaa Yerusaalemitti wanta mudate tokko ibsa. Barreessaan kun yeroo filannoo dura ijoollee xixiqqoo tokko tokko waa'ee eenyuuf akka sagalee kennu gaafatan akka isa mudate dubbata. Mudannoon kun haala siyaasaa biyyattii keessa jiru fi sababoota lammiilee Falasxiin irratti dhiibbaa fi jibbiinsa uumamaa jiru hubachuuf gargaara.

title: US has plans to strike Iran as early as tomorrow, report says
english: Reports indicate that the United States is preparing potential military strikes against Iran, strategically timed to coincide with the presence of three aircraft carriers in the region. While some officials favor continuing economic sanctions to weaken the Iranian government, others argue that direct military action is necessary. The window for this operation is constrained by the upcoming departure of a carrier and specific lunar conditions ideal for night attacks.
amharic: አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ ወታደራዊ ጥቃት ለመሰንዘር እቅድ እንዳላት መረጃዎች እየወጡ ነው። ጥቃቱ በክልሉ ውስጥ ሶስት አውሮፕላን ተሸካሚ መርከቦች በሚገኙበት ወቅት ይፈጸማል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል። አንዳንድ የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት ኢኮኖሚያዊ ማዕቀብ በቂ ነው ብለው ሲያምኑ፣ ሌሎች ግን ወታደራዊ እርምጃ ወሳኝ ነው የሚል አቋም አላቸው። የጥቃቱ መስኮት የመርከቦች እንቅስቃሴ እና የሌሊት ጨለማ ሁኔታን መሰረት ያደረገ ነው።
oromo: Amerikaa Iran irratti tarkaanfii waraanaa fudhachuuf karoora qabaachuu gabaasni ni mul'isa. Karoorri kun dooniiwwan xiyyaara fe'an sadii naannichatti argamanitti fayyadamuun kan raawwatamu ta'uu eerameera. Hoggantoonni Ameerikaa tokko tokko uggurri dinagdee gahaadha jedhanii kan amananii fi kaan immoo tarkaanfii waraanaa barbaachisaa dha kan jedhanidha. Yeroon tarkaanfichaaf mijataa ta'e kunis sochii dooniiwwan sanaa fi haala halkan irratti kan hundaa'e dha.

title: Bomb threats target seven flights across Europe
english: Seven passenger flights across Europe, including two from the UK, were subjected to security inspections following anonymous bomb threats. Authorities across multiple countries investigated the planes, but all searches were cleared after no explosives were discovered. While the UK government labeled the incidents as malicious hoaxes, officials are coordinating to determine if the threats were part of a coordinated effort to disrupt air travel.
amharic: በአውሮፓ የሚገኙ ሰባት የንግድ አውሮፕላኖች ስማቸው ባልተጠቀሰ አካላት በደረሱ የቦምብ ማስፈራሪያዎች ምክንያት የደህንነት ፍተሻ ተደርጎባቸዋል። የየአገራቱ ባለስልጣናት አውሮፕላኖቹን ቢፈትሹም ምንም ዓይነት ፈንጂ ሊያገኙ አልቻሉም። ምንም እንኳን የብሪታንያ መንግስት ክስተቱን የውሸት ማስፈራሪያ ብሎ ቢጠራውም፣ ባለስልጣናት በአየር ትራንስፖርት ላይ ተጽዕኖ ለመፍጠር የታቀደ የተቀናጀ ጥረት መሆኑን ለማወቅ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Xiyyaarota imaltoota fe’anii Awurooppaa keessa balali’aa turan torba irratti, akeekkachiisni boombii maqaa hin ibsamneen ergamee ture. Mootummoonni biyyoota garagaraa xiyyaarota kanneen sakatta’aniiru ta’us, erga qorannoo booda boombii tokkollee argachuu hin dandeenye. Mootummaan biyya Ingiliz gocha kana oduu kijibaati jechuun ibseera; ta’us, balaliinsa qilleensa irratti jeequmsa uumuuf kan karoorfame ta’uu isaa qorachuuf qindoominaan hojjatamaa jira.

title: Binance says fake job interviews used as part of $6.3bn crypto hack
english: Binance revealed that hackers stole $6.3 billion by targeting their engineers through fake job interviews and malicious software. The attackers gained trust by posing as recruiters and tricked an employee into downloading a file that compromised company systems. Binance has since apologized, secured customer funds, and is working with law enforcement to track the stolen assets.
amharic: ቢናንስ የተባለው ኩባንያ ጠላፊዎች የውሸት የስራ ቃለ-መጠይቆችን እና ጎጂ ሶፍትዌሮችን በመጠቀም 6.3 ቢሊዮን ዶላር መስረቃቸውን አስታውቋል። አጥቂዎቹ እንደ ቀጣሪ በመቅረብ የኩባንያውን መሐንዲስ በማታለል ኮምፒውተሩን እንዲበክል አድርገዋል። ኩባንያው ለተፈጠረው ችግር ይቅርታ የጠየቀ ሲሆን የተሰረቀውን ገንዘብ ለመመለስ እና ከህግ አስከባሪ አካላት ጋር በመተባበር ምርመራ እያደረገ ነው።
oromo: Binance akka ibsetetti, tuutni hattootaa qaxarrii sobaa fi sagantaa miidhaa geessisu fayyadamanii qarshii biliyoona 6.3 hataniiru. Hattoonni kunniin akka nama qaxaruutti of dhiyeessuun injinara isaanii gowwoomsuudhaan, sirna kompiitaraa isaanii cabsuu danda'aniiru. Binance miidhaa kanaan gaddi itti dhaga'amu ibsee, maallaqa bades deebisuuf fi qaamolee seeraa wajjin ta'uun qorannoo geggeessaa akka jiru beeksiseera.

title: Death toll rises in Ukraine after Russia attacks aid centre, hospice and hospital
english: Russian airstrikes across Ukraine have killed at least 38 civilians, with the deadliest attack hitting an aid distribution center in the Zaporizhzhia region. Additional strikes targeted a hospice in Dnipro and a hospital in Kharkiv, leaving dozens more people injured and many feared trapped under rubble. While Moscow claims it targeted military personnel, international observers indicate the attacks struck humanitarian sites and violated humanitarian laws.
amharic: በዩክሬን በተፈጸሙ የሩሲያ የአየር ጥቃቶች ቢያንስ 38 ሲቪሎች መሞታቸው ተገለጸ። ከጥቃቶቹ መካከል በዛፖሪዝሂያ የሚገኝ የዕርዳታ ማከፋፈያ ጣቢያ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሶበታል፤ በዲኒፕሮ እና በካርኪቭ በሚገኙ ሆስፒታሎች እና የህክምና ተቋማት ላይም ጥቃት ተፈጽሟል። ሩሲያ ወታደራዊ ኢላማዎችን መታሁ ብትልም፣ የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት እና ሌሎች ታዛቢዎች ጥቃቶቹ የሰብአዊ መብት ህጎችን የጣሱ መሆናቸውን በመግለጽ ጉዳቱ ሰላማዊ ሰዎችን ማዕከል ያደረገ መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Ukreen irratti haleellaa xiyyaaraa Ruusiyaan raawwatte kanaan namoonni nagaa yoo xiqqaate 38 ta'an du'aniiru. Haleellaa kana keessaa kan hammaate kutaa Zaapoorizhiyaatti bakka gargaarsi namoomaa raabsamu irratti kan raawwatame yoo ta'u, hospitaalonni Diiniproo fi Kaarkiv keessa jiranis haleellaaf saaxilamaniiru. Ruusiyaan waraana irratti kan xiyyeeffatte ta'uu ishee yoo dubbattus, dhaabbileen idil-addunyaa haleellaan kun buufataale gargaarsa namoomaa irratti kan raawwatamee fi seera waraana idil-addunyaa kan cabse ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Libya's top religious authority rules against wearing Nike clothes
english: Libya's top religious authority, the Dar al-Ifta, has issued a fatwa prohibiting the use of Nike clothing. The ruling claims the brand name and logo are linked to Greek pagan deities, which contradicts Islamic teachings, and also accuses the company of supporting Israel. While the edict holds significant social influence, it is not a legally enforceable government order, and public reaction to the announcement has been divided.
amharic: የሊቢያ ከፍተኛ የሃይማኖት ተቋም ዳር አል-ኢፍታ የናይክ ምርቶችን መጠቀምን የሚከለክል ፈትዋ አውጥቷል። ተቋሙ የናይክ ስም እና አርማ ከግሪክ ጣዖታት ጋር የተያያዙ በመሆናቸው ከእስልምና እምነት ጋር እንደሚጋጭ ገልጿል። በተጨማሪም ኩባንያው እስራኤልን ይደግፋል በሚል ክስ አቅርቦበታል። ምንም እንኳን ይህ ውሳኔ ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ ቢኖረውም፣ በሕግ አስገዳጅ የሆነ የመንግስት ትእዛዝ አይደለም።
oromo: Abbaan taayitaa amantii olaanaa Libiyaa kan ta'e 'Dar al-Ifta', uffata Nike fayyadamuu akka hin qabne labsii baaseera. Labsichi maqaan fi mallattoon Nike waaqeffannaa haraamaa fi waaqa Greek waliin kan wal qabatu akkasumas dhaabbatichi Israa'eliin gargaara jedhee himata. Labsichi dhiibbaa hawaasummaa guddaa qabaatus, seera mootummaa dirqisiisaa miti akkasumas namoota labsicha morman irratti tarkaanfiin seeraa hin fudhatamu.

title: Jerusalem Daily: Israel detains Al Jazeera journalist in Hebron raids
english: Israeli forces recently conducted raids in the Hebron area, leading to the arrest of Al Jazeera reporter Montaser Nassar. During these operations, reports emerged alleging that a prisoner was subjected to violence and mistreatment by soldiers. These incidents have drawn additional scrutiny due to concerns involving threats made by Israeli official Itamar Ben-Gvir.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በሄብሮን አካባቢ ባደረጉት ወረራ የአልጀዚራ ጋዜጠኛ የሆኑትን ሞንታሰር ናሳርን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። በተመሳሳይ ወቅት እስረኛ የሆኑ ሰዎች በወታደሮቹ ድብደባና ጥቃት እንደተፈጸመባቸው የሚገልጹ መረጃዎች ወጥተዋል። እነዚህ ድርጊቶች በእስራኤሉ ሚኒስትር ኢታማር ቤን-ግቪር ከተሰነዘሩት ማስፈራሪያዎች ጋር ተያይዞ ከፍተኛ ትኩረት ስበዋል።

Hojiiwwan kanaan walqabatee, hidhamtoonni waraana Israa'eliin reebichaa fi dararamaan akka isaan irra ga'e gabaasameera. Gochootni kunniin immoo, dhaadannoo ministira Israa'el Itaamaar Ben-Gviir biraa dhufeen walqabatee yaaddoo guddaa uumeera.

title: Russian strikes on Dnipro kill two, injure 20 others
english: Russian military strikes targeted residential neighborhoods in the city of Dnipro, resulting in two fatalities and leaving 20 people wounded. The attacks also caused significant damage to local healthcare infrastructure, specifically affecting a hospital and a hospice facility. The hospice was providing care for dozens of patients suffering from terminal illnesses at the time of the incident.
amharic: የሩሲያ ወታደራዊ ጥቃት በዲኒፕሮ ከተማ በሚገኙ መኖሪያ ቤቶች ላይ በመድረሱ የሁለት ሰዎች ህይወት ሲያልፍ ሌሎች 20 ሰዎች ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቱ ሆስፒታልን ጨምሮ በበርካታ የጤና ተቋማት ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት አድርሷል። ከጉዳቱ ከተጎዱት መካከል በጠና የታመሙ ታማሚዎች የሚረዱበት የህክምና ማዕከል ይገኝበታል።
oromo: Humni waraana Raashiyaa magaalaa Diiniipiroo keessatti bakkeewwan jireenyaa irratti haleellaa raawwateen namoonni lama lubbuun darban, 20 immoo madaa’an. Haleellaan kun hospitaalaafi iddoo namoonni dhukkuba cimaan qabaman itti gargaararaman dabalatee dhaabbilee fayyaa hedduu irratti miidhaa guddaa geessiseera.

title: South Carolina shrimpers weigh costs, vote in crucial US midterms
english: Shrimpers in South Carolina are heading to the polls amid concerns over rising fuel prices, equipment costs, and competition from imported products. Many are worried about President Trump's proposed budget cuts to the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA), which provides essential weather data for their safety. Consequently, some local fishermen are supporting Democratic candidates like Annie Andrews, who has promised to address the financial burdens facing coastal workers.
amharic: በደቡብ ካሮላይና የሚገኙ የሽሪምፕ አጥማጆች እየጨመረ በመጣው የነዳጅ ዋጋ፣ የመሳሪያ ወጪዎች እና ከውጭ በሚገቡ ምርቶች ተወዳዳሪነት ምክንያት በምርጫው ላይ ትኩረት አድርገዋል። አጥማጆቹ በተለይ ለደህንነታቸው አስፈላጊ የሆነውን የአየር ሁኔታ መረጃ የሚሰጠው የብሔራዊ ውቅያኖስና ከባቢ አየር አስተዳደር (NOAA) በፕሬዚዳንት ትራምፕ በጀት እንዲቀነስ መታቀዱ ስጋት ፈጥሮባቸዋል። በመሆኑም፣ አንዳንድ አጥማጆች የባህር ዳርቻ ኑሮን ለማሻሻል ቃል የገቡትን እንደ አኒ አንድሪውስ ያሉ የዴሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ እጩዎችን እየደገፉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Qotee bulaan qurxummii fi shrimpii biyya South Carolina gatii boba’aa dabalaa deemu, gatii meeshaalee fi dorgommii alaa keessaa ilaalchisee yaaddoo qabu. Hojjettoonni kunneen keessattuu, odeeffannoo qilleensaa kan isaan gargaaru dhaabbata NOAA irratti hojiin baajata hir’isuu pirezidaant Traamp yaadan isaan yaaddessee jira. Kanaafuu, namoonni kunneen kaadhimamtoota paartii Dimookiraata kan akka Annie Andrews deggaraa jiru; isheenis jireenya hawaasa qarqara galaana keessaa fooyyessuuf waadaa galtee jirti.

title: Darfur survivors vow to tell story of those killed after Sudan camp attacks
english: Survivors of the Zamzam displacement camp in Darfur are sharing their experiences following the brutal takeover of their community by the Rapid Support Forces in 2025. Residents described how a long-term blockade led to severe famine, forcing people to consume unconventional items like animal feed and mud just to survive. Now displaced once again, these individuals are determined to keep the memories of their destroyed community alive after losing all their personal belongings and homes.
amharic: በዳርፉር የዛምዛም መጠለያ ጣቢያ የተረፉ ሰዎች እ.ኤ.አ በ2025 በፈጣን ድጋፍ ሰጪ ኃይሎች (RSF) ከተፈጸመባቸው ጥቃት በኋላ የደረሰባቸውን ሰቆቃ እያስታወሱ ነው። ነዋሪዎቹ ለረጅም ጊዜ በተጣለባቸው የከበባ አዋጅ ምክንያት ለከፋ ረሃብ እንደተጋለጡና የከብት መኖን እንዲሁም ጭቃን ከመመገብ ውጭ አማራጭ እንዳልነበራቸው ተናግረዋል። በአሁኑ ወቅት በድጋሚ የተፈናቀሉት እነዚህ ግለሰቦች፣ ንብረታቸውና መኖሪያ ቤታቸው ቢወድም የነበሩበትን ማህበረሰብ ታሪክ ለትውልድ ለማስተላለፍ ቆርጠው ተነስተዋል።
oromo: Namoonni buufata godaantotaa Zamzam, Darfuur keessaa lubbuun hafan, bara 2025 humnoonni 'Rapid Support Forces' (RSF) qubata isaanii erga weeraranii booda miidhaa isaanirra ga'e haasawaa jiru. Jiraattonni humni kun daandiiwwan gabaa cufuun beela hamaa isaan qunnamuuf sababa ta'uu fi namoonni nyaata dhabanii nyaata horii fi biyyee nyaachuu akka dirqaman ibsaniiru. Yeroo ammaa deebi'anii kan godaanan kun, qabeenyi isaanii guutummaatti barbadaa'us, seenaa fi yaadannoo hawaasa isaanii kan miidhame sana namootaaf hiruuf murteessaniiru.

title: Barcelona vs Aston Villa LIVE: Champions League
english: Barcelona is set to face Aston Villa at the Camp Nou for a highly anticipated Champions League match. Aston Villa aims to maintain their undefeated streak in the tournament against the Spanish champions. The game is scheduled to begin at 9:00 PM local time.
amharic: ባርሴሎና በአስቶን ቪላ ላይ የሚያደርጉትን የቻምፒየንስ ሊግ ጨዋታ በሜዳቸው ካምፕ ኑ ያካሂዳሉ። አስቶን ቪላ እስካሁን በውድድሩ ያሳዩትን ጠንካራ አቋም ለመቀጠል ከስፔኑ ሻምፒዮን ጋር ይፋለማሉ። ጨዋታው በሀገር ውስጥ ሰዓት አቆጣጠር ከምሽቱ 3:00 ላይ ይጀምራል።
oromo: Barcelona fi Aston Villa tapha Champions League ta'e irratti buufata Camp Nou irratti wal morkatu. Aston Villa injifannoo walitti aansuudhaan taphoota isaanii itti fufuuf qophii ta'aniiru. Taphi kun sa'aatii biyyaa 3:00 irratti kan eegalu ta'a.

title: Report: Israeli finance ministry was unaware of plans to end US military aid
english: Israel's finance ministry was completely caught off guard by President Trump's recent announcement regarding the immediate termination of American military aid. This annual funding of $3.8 billion was previously counted on as a critical component for Israel's defense budget for the years 2027 and 2028. Officials in the ministry had no prior notice or knowledge that this financial support would be cut off.
amharic: የእስራኤል የገንዘብ ሚኒስቴር ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ የአሜሪካን ወታደራዊ እርዳታ ወዲያውኑ ለማቋረጥ የወሰዱትን ውሳኔ አስቀድመው አያውቁም ነበር። በየዓመቱ የሚሰጠው 3.8 ቢሊዮን ዶላር እርዳታ ለእስራኤል የ2027 እና የ2028 የመከላከያ በጀት ወሳኝ ግብዓት ተደርጎ ይታይ ነበር። ሚኒስቴሩ ስለ መቋረጡ ቀደም ሲል ምንም አይነት መረጃ አልነበረውም።
oromo: Ministeerri maallaqaa Israa'el, prezidaant Tiraamp gargaarsa waraanaa Ameerikaa yeroo hatattamaan dhaabuuf murteessan irratti duraan beekumsa homaa hin qaban turan. Gargaarsi waggaa waggaatti kennamu kan doolaara biliyoona 3.8 ta'e kun, baajata ittisa biyyaa kan Israa'el kan bara 2027 fi 2028 tiif akka maddaa maallaqaa ijoo ta'eetti yaadamaa ture. Ministeerichi waa'ee gargaarsa kana dhaabuu irratti beekumsa duraa tokkollee hin qabne.

title: Iran says US ceasefire proposal 'insufficient' as strikes are reported on Qeshm Island
english: Tensions between the US and Iran have escalated following US airstrikes on Iran's strategic Qeshm Island, even as both sides discuss potential ceasefire terms. Iranian officials rejected a recent US proposal, labeling it inadequate and insisting that Washington must first meet seven specific conditions, including lifting sanctions and ending port blockades. Despite ongoing diplomatic efforts mediated by Qatar, military skirmishes continue, including reports of downed drones and exchanges of fire near the Strait of Hormuz.
amharic: የአሜሪካ አየር ኃይል በኢራን ቁስም ደሴት ላይ ጥቃት ማድረሱን ተከትሎ በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ያለው ውጥረት አድጓል። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት አሜሪካ ያቀረበችውን የተኩስ አቁም አማራጭ በቂ አይደለም በማለት ውድቅ ያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ ድርድሩ ስኬታማ እንዲሆን አሜሪካ ማዕቀቦችን በማንሳት እና የወደብ እገዳዎችን በማቆም የኢራንን ሰባት ቅድመ ሁኔታዎች ማሟላት አለባት ብለዋል። በኳታር አሸማጋይነት የዲፕሎማሲ ጥረቶች እየተደረጉ ቢሆንም፣ በሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ አቅራቢያ የሚካሄዱ ወታደራዊ ግጭቶች እና የሰው አልባ አውሮፕላኖች መመታት ሁኔታውን አወሳስቦታል።
oromo: Humni waraana Ameerikaa bakkawwan tarsiimoo ta'an kan jiran ganda Qeshum irratti haleellaa qilleensa irraa gaggeessuun isaa waldhabdee Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduu jiru daran hammaateera. Hoggantoonni Iraan, Ameerikaan walii galtee tasgabii uumuuf dhiyeessite gahaa miti jechuun fudhachuu didaniiru; akkasumas Ameerikaan kaffaltii diinagdee kaasuu fi cufaa buufataalee dhabamsiisuun dabalatee haala tokko tokko guutuun akka irra jiru ibsaniiru. Kutaaleen biyyoota giddu galeessaa fi Qataar duula dippilomaasii gaggeessaa kan jiran ta'us, naannoo bishaan Hormuzitti haleellaa waraanaa fi qilleensa irraa kan wal-miidhan ta'uun isaanii sodaa waraana bal'aa uumeera.

title: Israeli prison guards ‘shot prominent Palestinian detainees nine times’
english: A prominent Palestinian detainee named Hassan Salameh was shot nine times by Israeli prison guards last month. This violent incident followed a confrontation where Israel's National Security Minister, Itamar Ben Gvir, reportedly entered Salameh's cell to threaten his life on camera. Reports of the attack were confirmed by a prisoners' rights group after a lawyer was finally able to visit the inmate.
amharic: ሃሰን ሳላሜህ የተባሉ ታዋቂ የፍልስጤም እስረኛ ባለፈው ወር በእስር ቤት ጠባቂዎች ዘጠኝ ጊዜ በጥይት ተመተው መቁሰላቸው ተነግሯል። ይህ ጥቃት የተፈጸመው የእስራኤል ብሄራዊ ደህንነት ሚኒስትር ኢታማር ቤን ግቪር ወደ እስረኛው ክፍል በመግባት በቪዲዮ እየቀረጹ የሞት ዛቻ ካደረሱባቸው በኋላ ነው። የፍልስጤም እስረኞች መብት ተሟጋች ቡድን አንድ ጠበቃ እስረኛውን ከጎበኙ በኋላ ይህንን አስደንጋጭ መረጃ ይፋ አድርጓል።
oromo: Hassan Salaameeh kan jedhaman hidhamaan Falasxiin beekamtii qaban tokko, ji’a darbe gidduu galeessa hidhaa Israa’el keessatti waardiyyonni sagal itti dhukaasanii miidhaa irraan ga’aniiru. Ajjeechaan kun kan raawwatame, Ministirri Nageenya Biyoolessaa Israa’el Itaamaar Ben Gviir gara kutaa hidhaa isaa seenanii viidiyoodhaan qabataa du’aan isaan sodaachisanii erga ba’anii booda. Gareen mirga hidhamtootaa falmu tokko, abbaan seeraa tokko hidhamaa kana erga daawwatee booda odeeffannoo miidhaa kanaa mirkaneesseera.

title: Israel's Eisenkot says US aid cut shows Netanyahu 'must be replaced'
english: Israeli opposition figure Gadi Eisenkot has called for Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s removal following reports of a potential reduction in U.S. military aid. Eisenkot criticized the Prime Minister for failing to inform Israel’s defense officials about this significant strategic shift before it appeared in the media. He argued that this lack of transparency demonstrates that Netanyahu is no longer fit to lead the country.
amharic: የእስራኤል ተቃዋሚ ፖለቲከኛ ጋዲ አይዘንኮት፣ የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ እርዳታ ሊቀንስ እንደሚችል ከተነገረ በኋላ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ ከስልጣን ሊነሱ ይገባል ሲሉ ተናገሩ። አይዘንኮት ስለ ወሳኙ የፖሊሲ ለውጥ የመከላከያ ተቋማት ሳይቀር ከመገናኛ ብዙኃን መስማታቸው የጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩን አስተዳደር አደገኛነት ያሳያል ብለዋል። በዚህ ድርጊታቸውም መሪው አመኔታ እንዳጡና ቦታቸውን መልቀቅ እንዳለባቸው አስረድተዋል።
oromo: Mormaan biyya Israa'el Gadi Eisenkot, gargaarsi waraanaa Ameerikaa hir'achuu danda'a jedhamee erga dhaga'amee booda, Ministirri Muummee Beniyaamiin Netiyaahuu aangoo gadi lakkisuu qabu jedhaniiru. Eisenkot, jijjiirama tarsiimawaa kana dhaabbileen ittisa biyyattii otoo hin beekin miidiyaadhaan dhagahamuun isaa, hogganaa biyyattii kana irratti amantaa akka hin qabne ibsaniiru. Gochi kunis hogganaan biyyattii kun qajeelfama gaariin hojjachaa akka hin jirre kan argisiisu ta'uu dubbataniiru.

title: Saudi defence minister and Hegseth discuss latest Houthi attacks
english: Saudi Defence Minister Khalid bin Salman recently held a phone call with US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth to address regional stability. The two leaders focused their conversation on ongoing Houthi military actions targeting Saudi Arabia. Additionally, they reviewed strategies to strengthen defense cooperation and reduce overall tensions within the Gulf region.
amharic: የሳዑዲ መከላከያ ሚኒስትር ካሊድ ቢን ሳልማን ከአሜሪካው አቻቸው ፒት ሄግሴዝ ጋር በስልክ ተወያይተዋል። ውይይቱ በዋናነት ያተኮረው በሳዑዲ አረቢያ ላይ እየደረሱ ባሉ የሁቲ ጥቃቶች እና በቀጠናው ውጥረትን ለመቀነስ በሚቻልባቸው መንገዶች ላይ ነው። ሁለቱ ወገኖች በጋራ መከላከያ ጉዳዮች ላይ ያላቸውን ትብብር ለማጠናከር ተስማምተዋል።
oromo: Ministirri ittisa biyya Saudi Khalid bin Salman fi ministirri ittisa Ameerikaa Pete Hegseth waa’ee nageenya naannichaa irratti bilbilaan mari’ataniiru. Mariin isaanii inni guddaan haleellaa gareen Houthi Saudi irratti gaggeessaa jiruufi akkaataa waldhabdee naannoo Ganaatti hir’isuu danda’amu irratti kan xiyyeeffate ture. Kana malees, waliigaltee ittisaa cimsuufi hariiroo nageenyaa irratti mari’ataniiru.

title: Thousands of European troops to rehearse Ukraine deployment in event of peace
english: European nations, led by the UK and France, are conducting a large-scale military exercise in Poland to prepare a multinational force for potential deployment to Ukraine should a peace agreement be reached. Nearly 3,000 soldiers from 12 countries will practice logistics and command operations to ensure they can support Ukraine’s long-term stability and military rebuilding. Officials clarified that these troops would not engage in combat or operate under NATO command, despite strong opposition from Russia regarding any foreign military presence.
amharic: የዩናይትድ ኪንግደም እና የፈረንሳይ መሪነት በፖላንድ የሚካሄድ ትልቅ ወታደራዊ ልምምድ እየተደረገ ሲሆን፣ ይህም የሰላም ስምምነት ከተፈጠረ ለዩክሬን ድጋፍ የሚውል ሁለገብ ኃይል ለማዘጋጀት ያለመ ነው። ከ12 የአውሮፓ አገራት የተውጣጡ ወደ 3,000 የሚጠጉ ወታደሮች የሎጂስቲክስ እና የአዛዥነት ዝግጅቶችን በመለማመድ የዩክሬንን የረጅም ጊዜ ደህንነት ለመጠበቅ እየሰሩ ነው። እነዚህ ወታደሮች በጦርነት ውስጥ እንደማይሳተፉ እና በኔቶ ትዕዛዝ ስር እንደማይሆኑ የተገለጸ ቢሆንም፣ ሩሲያ በዩክሬን ምድር የውጭ ኃይል መገኘቱን እንደማትቀበል በግልጽ አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Biyyoonni Awurooppaa, kanneen akka UK fi Faransaay durfamuun, yoo nagaan bu'e humna biyyoota hedduu of keessaa qabu gara Yukreeniif bobbaasuuf qophii isaanii Poolaanditti gochaa jiru. Waraanni 3,000 gahu biyyoota 12 irraa walitti dhufan, humna Yukreeniif gargaarsa ta'uu danda'uuf qophii logistikii fi ajajaa irratti leenji'aa jiru. Humnoonni kun waraana keessa akka hin galle fi ajaja Neetoo (NATO) jalatti akka hin hiriirre himamee jiraatus, Raashiyaan humna alaa Yukreen keessatti argamu mormuu ishee ibsiteetti.

title: Explosions hit Iran’s Qeshm Island as US media report US strikes in Hormuz
english: Several explosions were reported on Iran's Qeshm Island and in the city of Bandar Lengeh following sightings of aircraft in the area. US officials have confirmed that the American military conducted defensive strikes in the Strait of Hormuz. These operations were reportedly intended to prevent Iranian interference with commercial shipping lanes while avoiding a broader military conflict.
amharic: በኢራን ኩሽም ደሴት እና በባንዳር ሌንጌህ ከተማ በርካታ ፍንዳታዎች መከሰታቸው ተዘግቧል። የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት እንዳረጋገጡት፣ የአገሪቱ ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት አካባቢ የመከላከያ ጥቃቶችን ፈጽመዋል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች የተፈጸሙት የኢራንን የንግድ መርከቦች የመረበሽ አቅም ለመገደብ ሲሆን፣ ሰፊ ግጭትን ለማስወገድም ታቅዶ ነበር።
oromo: Oddeeffannoon akka ibsutti, qarqara galaana Iran fi magaalaa Bandar Lengeh keessatti dhoohawwan hedduun dhaga'amaniiru. Mootummaan Amerikaa akka ibseetti, waraanni isaanii lafa Hormuz keessatti tarkaanfii of-irraa ittisuu fudhateera. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame daldala markabaa kan Iran akka hin gufachiisneef yoo ta'u, waraana bal'aa hambisuuf yaadamee kan gaggeeffameedha.

title: US lawmakers ask Trump administration to stop deportation of Afghans
english: A group of 66 US lawmakers has urged the Trump administration to halt the planned deportation of at least 150 Afghans to Pakistan. Many of these individuals previously supported American forces and face severe risks, including potential death, if they are returned to Afghanistan under Taliban rule. The legislators argue that this action violates humanitarian commitments and places vulnerable people in extreme danger.
amharic: 66 የዩኤስ ህግ አውጪዎች የትራምፕ አስተዳደር ቢያንስ 150 አፍጋኒስታናውያንን ወደ ፓኪስታን ለመላክ ያቀደውን እቅድ እንዲያቆም ጠይቀዋል። ከእነዚህ ግለሰቦች መካከል ብዙዎቹ ቀደም ሲል ከአሜሪካ ኃይሎች ጋር አብረው የሰሩ ሲሆን ወደ አፍጋኒስታን ከተመለሱ ለከፍተኛ አደጋ እና ለሞት ሊዳረጉ ይችላሉ። ህግ አውጪዎቹ ይህ ድርጊት ሰብአዊ መብትን የሚጥስ እና ተጋላጭ የሆኑ ሰዎችን ለአደጋ የሚያጋልጥ መሆኑን በመግለጽ ተቃውሟቸውን አሰምተዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni fi miseensonni mana maree US 66 ta'an, mootummaan Donald Trump namoota Afgaanistaan 150 ta'an gara Paakistaanitti deebisuuf karoorse akka dhaabu gaafataniiru. Namoonni kun hedduun isaanii yeroo darbe waraana Ameerikaa waliin hojjetaniiru, kanaafis gara biyya isaanii yoo deebi'an mootummaa Taalibaanin ajjeefamuuf ykn miidhamuuf carraa guddaa qabu. Miseensonni kun tarkaanfiin kun heera namoomaa kan cabsu fi namoota nagaa balaaf kan saaxilu ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Multiple Russian strikes kill at least 26 at Ukraine aid centre
english: At least 26 people lost their lives after Russian forces conducted dual missile strikes on a school serving as a humanitarian aid facility in Ukraine's Zaporizhzhia region. President Zelenskyy stated that the military executed an initial attack followed by a second strike on the building where civilians had sought shelter. This incident has caused significant casualties among those relying on the center for essential support.
amharic: ዩክሬን በሚገኘው የዛፖሪዝሂያ ክልል ሰብዓዊ እርዳታ ማዕከል ሆኖ በሚያገለግል ትምህርት ቤት ላይ የሩሲያ ኃይሎች በፈጸሙት ሁለት ተከታታይ ጥቃት ቢያንስ 26 ሰዎች ተገድለዋል። የዩክሬን ፕሬዝዳንት እንደገለጹት፣ መጀመሪያ ጥቃት ከተፈጸመ በኋላ ሰዎች ተጠልለውበት በነበረው ሕንፃ ላይ ሁለተኛው ጥቃት ተከስቷል። ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት እርዳታ ፈላጊ የሆኑ ንጹሃን ዜጎች ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት አድርሷል።
oromo: Godina Zaaporiizhiyaa kan Yookireen keessatti, bakka gargaarsa namoomaa kennuuf tajaajilaa ture manneen barnootaa irratti, waraanni Raashiyaa haleellaa lama walitti aansuun raawwateen namoonni 26 ol du'aniiru. Pirezedantiin Yookireen akka ibsanitti, haleellaa jalqabaa booda, namoonni bakka sanatti harka galfatanii turan irratti haleellaan lammaffaan raawwatameera. Haleellaa kana hordofuunis namoota gargaarsa barbaadaa turan irratti miidhaan cimaan ga'eera.

title: Yemeni government forces launch strikes on Houthi positions west of Taiz
english: Yemeni government forces conducted airstrikes against Houthi military targets in the Jabal Habashi region, leading to several Houthi casualties. In a separate incident, Houthi media claimed that a different attack near Taiz hit a factory, resulting in three deaths and eight injuries. These events highlight the ongoing military escalation between the government and Houthi fighters in the Taiz area.
amharic: የየመን መንግስት ኃይሎች በጃባል ሀባሺ አካባቢ በሚገኙ የሁቲ ወታደራዊ ቦታዎች ላይ የአየር ጥቃት በመሰንዘር በቡድኑ ላይ ጉዳት አድርሰዋል። በሌላ በኩል የሁቲ ሚዲያዎች እንደዘገቡት በታኢዝ በኩል የተፈፀመ ሌላ ጥቃት የጫማ ፋብሪካን በመምታቱ ሶስት ሰዎች ሲሞቱ ስምንት ሰዎች ቆስለዋል። ይህ ግጭት በታኢዝ አካባቢ በመንግስት እና በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች መካከል ያለው የውጊያ መቀጠልን ያሳያል።
oromo: Humnoonni mootummaa Yaman naannoo Jabal Habashitti bakka waraanni Huti itti argamu irratti haleellaa qilleensa irraa raawwataniin garee sana irratti miidhaan gaheera. Gamtaan, miidiyaaleen Huti akka gabaasanitti, haleellaa biraa Ta'iz irraa kaabaan argamu irratti raawwatameen warshaanshee kophee rukutamee namoonni sadan ajjeefamanii saddeeti immoo madaa'aniiru. Gochootni kun walitti bu'iinsa naannoo Ta'izitti mootummaa fi loltoota Huti gidduutti itti fufe ibsu.

title: Report: US launched strikes on Iran
english: Reports indicate that the United States military has conducted targeted strikes against locations in southern Iran. These actions are reportedly part of a series of covert operations carried out by Washington in the region. The attacks occurred despite previous assurances from President Trump that military action against Iran would not be pursued following the midterm elections.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በደቡባዊ ኢራን ላይ ጥቃት መፈጸማቸውን ዘገባዎች አመልክተዋል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች ዋሽንግተን በምስጢር እያከናወነች ካለችው ተከታታይ ውስን ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴዎች መካከል የሚመደቡ ናቸው። ጥቃቶቹ የተፈጸሙት ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ከምርጫ በኋላ በኢራን ላይ ጥቃት እንደማይከፍቱ ከተናገሩ በኋላ መሆኑ መነጋገሪያ ሆኗል።
oromo: gabaasni akka ibsutti, waraanni Ameerikaa kutaalee kibba Iraan irratti haleellaa raawwateera. Haleellaan kun tarkaanfiiwwan icitiin Washington naannichatti fudhachaa jirtu keessaa kan maddu ta'uun gabaafameera. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame, pireezidaant Tiraamp filannoo gidduu galeessaatti booda Iraan irratti waraana akka hin banne ibsanii turanittis ta'e.

title: 'Show courage' and end Netanyahu's government, Tibi urges Israeli opposition leader
english: Palestinian politician Ahmad Tibi has called on Israeli opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot to join forces with Arab parties to remove Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu from power. Tibi emphasized that there is no valid reason to avoid collaborating with Palestinian representatives, who hold a record 19 seats in the Knesset. Since neither major political bloc can reach a parliamentary majority on their own, Tibi believes this partnership is necessary to establish a new government.
amharic: የፍልስጤማዊው የፓርላማ አባል አህመድ ቲቢ የእስራኤል ተቃዋሚ መሪ ጋዲ አይዘንኮት የጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ አስተዳደርን ለማስወገድ ከአረብ ፓርቲዎች ጋር እንዲተባበሩ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ቲቢ አክለውም በፓርላማው 19 መቀመጫዎችን የያዙትን የፍልስጤም ወገንተኛ ፓርቲዎችን ማግለል ምንም ዓይነት ዲሞክራሲያዊ ምክንያት እንደሌለው ገልጸዋል። ማንኛውም የፖለቲካ ቡድን ያለ አረብ ፓርቲዎች ድጋፍ አብላጫውን መቀመጫ ማግኘት ስለማይችሉ፣ ይህ ትብብር አዲሱን መንግሥት ለመመስረት ወሳኝ እንደሆነ ተጠቅሷል።
oromo: Miseensi paarlaamaa Paalastayinii Ahmad Tiibii, gaggeessaan mormituu Israa'el Gaadii Ayizenkootiin mootummaa Binyaamiin Netaanyaahuu kuffisuuf garee Arabootaa waliin akka hojjetu gaafataniiru. Tiibiin akka jedhanitti, gareewwan Paalastayinii paarlaamaa keessatti teessoo 19 qaban waliin hojjechuu diduuf sababa dimokraatawaa hin jiru. Gareen siyaasaa kamiyyuu deeggarsa paartilee kanaa malee teessoo gahaa argachuu waan hin dandeenyeef, deeggarsa kana argachuun mootummaa haaraa hundeessuuf murteessaa dha.

title: Blasts heard in southern Iran
english: Multiple explosions were reported overnight in the southern region of Iran. The incidents specifically occurred on Qeshm Island near the Strait of Hormuz and in the coastal city of Bandar Lengeh. Authorities are currently noting these reports, although the exact cause of the blasts remains unclear.
amharic: ባለፈው ሌሊት በደቡባዊ ኢራን አካባቢዎች ተከታታይ ፍንዳታዎች ተሰምተዋል። ፍንዳታዎቹ የተከሰቱት በሆርሙዝ ባህር ወሽመጥ በሚገኘው የቄሽም ደሴት እና በባንዳር ሌንጌ የባህር ዳርቻ ከተማ ነው። ስለ ፍንዳታዎቹ መንስኤ እስካሁን የታወቀ ነገር የለም።
oromo: Halkan darbe kibba Iraan keessatti sagaleen dhoohaa dhaga'ameera. Dhoohaan kun kan mudate sulula Hormuzitti kan argamtu qarqara bishaan Qeshm irratti fi magaalaa qarqara galaana Bandar Lengeh jedhamtu keessatti dha. Sababa dhoohaa kanaa ilaalchisee hanga ammaatti ifa ta'e tokkollee hin jiru.

title: Israeli forces push into Quneitra, Syrian media report
english: Syrian media reports that Israeli military forces have entered the village of al-Asbah in the southern Quneitra region using five vehicles. This follows several other reported incidents on Monday, including military aircraft flights and the setup of temporary checkpoints in the area. These actions are part of a series of recent border maneuvers monitored by local observers.
amharic: የሶሪያ ሚዲያዎች እንደዘገቡት የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በአምስት ተሽከርካሪዎች ታጅበው በደቡባዊ ኩኔይትራ ወደሚገኘው አል-አስባህ መንደር ገብተዋል። ይህ ክስተት ሰኞ ዕለት ከተፈጸሙ ሌሎች ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴዎች ማለትም የአውሮፕላን በረራዎች እና የፍተሻ ጣቢያዎችን ከመትከል ጋር ተያይዞ የተከናወነ ነው። የአካባቢው ታዛቢዎች እንደገለጹት ይህ ድርጊት በድንበር አካባቢ እየታዩ ካሉ ተከታታይ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻዎች መካከል አንዱ ነው።
oromo: Miidiyaaleen Sooriyaa akka gabaasanitti, humnoonni waraana Israa'el konkolaattota shan fayyadamuun gara baadiyyaa quneitraa keessatti argamu ganda al-Asbah seenaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun gannata ganda sanaa keessatti balaliii xiyyaaraa fi iddoowwan qorannoo waraanaa dhaabuu dabalatee gochoota waraanaa kanneen biroo kanaan dura raawwataman hordofee kan dhufeedha. Gochi kun sochii waraanaa daangaa irratti yeroo dhihoo as dabalaa dhufe keessaa isa tokko ta'uun ibsameera.

title: Russian bombing kills 26 people at Ukraine aid centre, Kyiv says
english: At least 26 people were killed after Russian forces dropped multiple aerial bombs on a humanitarian aid center in the Ukrainian village of Komyshuvakha. President Zelensky condemned the attack, which targeted a school building used by residents for shelter and supplies, noting that rescuers were repeatedly hindered by ongoing drone strikes. Local officials fear the death toll could rise further as recovery teams continue to search through the rubble.
amharic: ሩሲያ በዩክሬኗ ኮሚሹቫካ መንደር በሚገኝ የሰብአዊ እርዳታ ማከፋፈያ ማዕከል ላይ ባደረሰችው የቦምብ ጥቃት ቢያንስ 26 ሰዎች መገደላቸው ተገለጸ። ፕሬዚዳንት ዘለንስኪ ጥቃቱን አረመኔያዊ ሲሉ ያወገዙት ሲሆን፣ በቦምብ የተመታው ትምህርት ቤት ነዋሪዎች መጠለያ እና እርዳታ የሚያገኙበት እንደነበር አስታውቀዋል። የነፍስ አድን ስራው በድሮን ጥቃቶች መስተጓጎሉን የገለጹት ባለሥልጣናት፣ በፍርስራሹ ስር ሌሎች ሰዎች ሊኖሩ እንደሚችሉ በመስጋት ፍለጋውን ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Rusiyyaan buufata gargaarsa namoota rakkatanii kan magaalaa Ukreen Komishuvakhaa irratti boombii buusteen namoonni 26 ol du’aniiru. Pirezidanti Zelenskiin ajjeechaa kana balaaleffatanii, iddoon kun manneen barnootaa kan lammiileen gargaarsa itti argatan akka ture ibsaniiru. Ogeeyyonni gargaarsaa iddoo miidhaan irra gahetti yeroo hedduu duula diroonii Rusiyaan geggeessituun gufataa akka turan gabaasameera; namoonni biroo diigama jala jiraachuu waan maluuf, hojiin barbaacha ammas itti fufee jira.

title: Shop freezers in seven European countries hit by cyber-attack
english: A cyber-attack has targeted supermarket refrigeration systems across seven European countries, causing freezers to switch into defrost mode and spoil large amounts of food. The hack affected chains in nations including Belgium, Sweden, and Ireland by exploiting remote maintenance systems. Authorities are now investigating the incident, which follows a similar major attack that occurred in France last month.
amharic: በሰባት የአውሮፓ ሀገራት በሚገኙ ሱፐርማርኬቶች ላይ በተፈጸመ የሳይበር ጥቃት፣ የማቀዝቀዣዎች የሙቀት መጠን በመቀየሩ ከፍተኛ መጠን ያለው የምግብ ክምችት እንዲበላሽ ሆኗል። ጥቃቱ ቤልጅየምን፣ ስዊድን እና አየርላንድን ጨምሮ በተለያዩ ሀገራት ያሉ የሱፐርማርኬት መደብሮች ላይ ተፅዕኖ አሳድሯል። ባለስልጣናት ችግሩን ለመፍታት እና ከአንድ ወር በፊት በፈረንሳይ ከደረሰው ተመሳሳይ ጥቃት ጋር ያለውን ግንኙነት ለማጣራት ምርመራ እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Hojiin garee hakkeroonni biyyoota Awurooppaa torba keessatti argaman keessatti, sirna qabbaneessaa konkolaataa nyaataa fi firijiwwan suupparmarkeetii irratti haleellaa raawwataniiru. Haleellaa kanaan firijiwwan gara dafiroostiitti waan jijjiiramaniif, nyaanni hedduun manca'uuf dirqameera. Biyyoonni haleellaa kanaan miidhaman keessaa biyyoonni akka Beeljiyeem, Swiidin fi Ayirlaandi ni argamu; ammatti qaamni dhimmi ilaallatu haleellaa kana qorachaa jira.

title: Fighting returns to Kherson region after longest Ukraine war ceasefire
english: Military operations have resumed in the Kherson region following a six-day humanitarian ceasefire, the longest since Russia's 2022 invasion. While the break allowed hundreds of civilians to escape occupied areas, both sides admitted to using the time to regroup and resupply their forces. Despite the successful cooperation between Russian and Ukrainian officials to facilitate the truce, the Kremlin has dismissed hopes that this event will lead to broader peace talks or further ceasefires.
amharic: ከ2022 የሩሲያ ወረራ ወዲህ ረጅሙ የተባለለት የስድስት ቀን የተኩስ አቁም ከተጠናቀቀ በኋላ በኬርሰን ክልል ዳግም ውጊያ ተቀስቅሷል። ይህ የሰብአዊ እረፍት መቶዎችን ለማስለቀቅ ቢረዳም፣ ሁለቱም ወገኖች ጊዜውን ጦር ኃይላቸውን እንደገና ለማደራጀት እንደተጠቀሙበት አምነዋል። በሁለቱ አገራት ተወካዮች መካከል የተደረገው የትብብር ስራ ቢሳካም፣ ክሬምሊን ይህ ክስተት ወደ ሰፊ የሰላም ንግግሮች እንደሚሸጋገር ያላቸውን ተስፋ አጣጥሏል።
oromo: Hojiin waraanaa naannoo Kherson keessatti erga guyyaa jahaaf turedhee booda, waraana bara 2022 jalqabee asii asitti yeroo dheeraaf turee, deebi'ee jalqabameera. Boqonnaan namoomaa kun uummata dhibbaan lakkaa'amu bakka waraana jalaa baasuuf gargaareera; ta'us, gamni lamaanuu yeroo kana humna isaanii walitti qabachuuf akka itti fayyadaman himaniiru. Gaggeessitoonni biyyoota lamaanii waliigaltee kana milkeessuuf yoo hojjatan illee, mootummaan Raashiyaa ta'iin kun gara marii nagaatti akka geessu abdiin jiru akka hin jirre ibseera.

title: Man guilty of stealing cash from farm owned by South African president
english: A South African court has convicted a man named Imanuwela David and a farm worker for stealing over half a million dollars in cash from President Cyril Ramaphosa’s Phala Phala property in 2020. The theft, which involved money hidden inside furniture, sparked a major political scandal known as Farmgate after accusations that the president failed to properly report the incident. While the individuals have now been found guilty of the break-in, the president continues to deny any personal misconduct regarding the event.
amharic: የደቡብ አፍሪካ ፍርድ ቤት ኢማኑዌላ ዴቪድ የተባለ ሰው እና አንድ የእርሻ ሰራተኛ እ.ኤ.አ በ2020 ከፕሬዝዳንት ሲሪል ራማፎሳ የእርሻ ቦታ ከግማሽ ሚሊዮን ዶላር በላይ የሰረቁ መሆናቸውን አረጋግጧል። በሶፋ ውስጥ ተደብቆ የነበረው ይህ የገንዘብ ስርቆት፣ ፕሬዝዳንቱ ጉዳዩን ለፖሊስ በወቅቱ አላሳወቁም በሚል ከፍተኛ የፖለቲካ ቀውስ ቀስቅሶ ነበር። ጥፋተኞቹ በስርቆቱ ወንጀል ጥፋተኛ ቢባሉም፣ ፕሬዝዳንት ራማፎሳ ግን ከጉዳዩ ጋር በተያያዘ ምንም አይነት ህገ-ወጥ ድርጊት እንዳልፈጸሙ መካዳቸውን ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Mana murtii Afrikaa Kibbaa, namni Imanuwela David jedhamu fi hojjetaan qonnaa tokko bara 2020 mana qonnaa Pireezidaant Siiril Raamafoozaa keessaa maallaqa doolaara kuma dhibba shan ol hatuu isaanii mirkaneesseera. Maallaqni saofa keessatti dhokfame hatamuun isaa, pireezidaantichi hatuu kana seeraan hin gabaasne jechuun, rakkoo siyaasaa guddaa kan uume yoo ta'u, kunis 'Farmgate' jedhamee beekama. Namoonni kunneen yakka hatuu kanaan qabamuus, pireezidaantichi garuu dhimmicha irratti yakka tokkollee akka hin raawwanne ammas ni haalu.

title: HRW calls on Zambia to halt post-election crackdown
english: Human Rights Watch has urged the Zambian government to end its aggressive crackdown on political opponents, journalists, and lawyers following the August 2026 elections. The organization reports that security forces have been involved in the arbitrary detention, disappearance, and physical abuse of government critics. They are demanding an immediate stop to these human rights violations, the release of those wrongfully held, and a thorough investigation into the violence, including the killing of a former cabinet official.
amharic: ሂዩማን ራይትስ ዋች የዛምቢያ መንግስት ከነሐሴ 2026 ምርጫ ወዲህ በተቃዋሚዎች፣ ጋዜጠኞች እና ጠበቆች ላይ እየወሰደ ያለውን ከፍተኛ የኃይል እርምጃ እንዲያቆም ጠይቋል። ድርጅቱ የጸጥታ ኃይሎች መንግስትን የሚተቹ ሰዎችን ያለ አግባብ ማሰራቸውን፣ ማሰቃየታቸውን እና አንዳንዶቹንም ማሰወራቸውን በሪፖርቱ አስታውቋል። የሰብአዊ መብት ተቋሙ እነዚህን ጥሰቶች በአስቸኳይ እንዲያቆሙ፣ በግፍ የታሰሩ እንዲፈቱ እና የቀድሞ ካቢኔ አባል ግድያን ጨምሮ ለተፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች ገለልተኛ ምርመራ እንዲደረግ አሳስቧል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni mirga namoomaa Human Rights Watch mootummaan Zaambiyaa filannoo Hagayya 2026 booda mormitoota, gaazexeessitoota fi abbootii seeraa irratti tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachaa jiru akka dhaabu gaafateera. Dhaabbatichi akka gabaasetti, humnoonni nageenyaa namoota mootummaa morman hidhuu, dararuu fi baay’ee isaanii immoo akka badu gochuun isaanii himameera. Dhaabbatichi dararaa kana battala dhaabuu, namoota seeraan alatti hidhaman gadhiisuu fi ajjeechaa duraanii ministira kaabineetiin raawwatame dabalatee qorannoon walaba ta'e akka gaggeeffamu barbaada.

title: Protester’s ‘I support genocide’ sign appears to face no police action
english: A woman at a protest in London carried a sign advocating for genocide without being detained by law enforcement. Authorities did not arrest her because simply displaying such a message does not violate existing UK criminal laws. This incident has drawn attention to the boundaries of free speech and legal definitions regarding protest materials.
amharic: ለንደን ውስጥ በተካሄደ የተቃውሞ ሰልፍ ላይ አንዲት ሴት የዘር ማጥፋትን እንደምትደግፍ የሚገልጽ ምልክት ብትይዝም በፖሊስ አልታሰረችም። በዩኬ ህግ መሰረት እንዲህ አይነት መልእክት የያዘ ምልክት መያዝ ብቻውን የወንጀል ድርጊት ስላልሆነ ፖሊስ እርምጃ መውሰድ አልቻለም። ይህ ክስተት የመናገር ነፃነትን እና በህግ የተደነገጉ ገደቦችን በተመለከተ ውይይት እንዲነሳ አድርጓል።
oromo: Magala Landanitti hiriira tokko irratti dubartiin tokko mallattoo 'sanyii balleessuu nan deggera' jedhu qabattee argamtus, poolisiin ishee hin hidhu. Seerri biyya Ingilizii mallattoo akkasii qabatanii argamuu qofaaf namarratti tarkaanfii seeraa fudhachuu waan hin hayyamneef poolisiin ishee hin qabne. Taateen kun bilisummaa yaadaa ibsuu fi daangaa seeraa irratti marii uumeera.

title: Lindsay Clancy in court to drop child murder charges after mistrial
english: Lindsay Clancy has returned to a Massachusetts court to request that murder charges against her be dismissed following a mistrial in her case regarding the 2023 killing of her three children. Her defense team argues that a new trial would violate her rights, claiming the previous judge failed to properly handle reports of juror misconduct during deliberations. While prosecutors intend to proceed with a retrial, the defense contends that the initial judicial process was flawed and insufficient, warranting a dismissal of the case.
amharic: ሊንዚ ክላንሲ እ.ኤ.አ. በ2023 ሶስት ልጆቿን በመግደል የተከሰሰችበት ጉዳይ ፍርድ ቤት ሳይወስን በመቅረቱ፣ ክሱ እንዲቋረጥላት ወደ ፍርድ ቤት ቀርባለች። የተከላካይ ጠበቆቿ እንደተናገሩት ከሆነ ዳኛው በችሎቱ ወቅት በተፈጠረ የዳኞች ችግር ላይ በቂ ምርመራ ባለማድረጋቸው፣ ዳግም መሞከሯ የሕገ-መንግሥታዊ መብቷን ይጥሳል። አቃቤ ህጉ ጉዳዩ እንደገና እንዲታይ ቢጠይቅም፣ የመከላከያ ቡድኑ ግን የፍርድ ሂደቱ ጉድለት ያለበት በመሆኑ ክሱ ሙሉ ለሙሉ መውረድ አለበት ብለው ይከራከራሉ።
oromo: Liinzii Klaansii ijoollee ishee sadii ajjeeste jedhamtee himatamtee booda, dhaddachi murtoo tokko malee waan xumurameef himatichi akka irraa ka'uuf gara mana murtii deebiteetti. Abukaatonni ishee akka jedhanitti, abbaan murtii yeroo murtii kennamaa turetti dhimma miseensa gumii murtoo irratti dhalateef xiyyeeffannoo gahaa waan hin kennineef, irra deebi'anii ishee himachuun mirga ishee sarba jedhaniiru. Abbaan alangaa himaticha irra deebi'uuf kan barbaadu ta'us, gareen ittistuu himatichaa adeemsi mana murtii durii dogoggora waan qabuuf himatichi guutummaatti akka haqamu gaafachaa jiru.

title: Trump asks Supreme Court to block 20,000 California ballots before midterms
english: President Trump has requested the Supreme Court to halt the counting of over 20,000 mail-in ballots in California, alleging those voters are not U.S. citizens. California officials argue the government's data is unreliable and that the move could wrongly disqualify many eligible voters. Lower courts have already rejected the administration's request, noting that separating these specific ballots at this late stage would be practically impossible.
amharic: ፕሬዚዳንት ትራምፕ በካሊፎርኒያ ከ20,000 በላይ የሚሆኑ በፖስታ የተላኩ የድምፅ መስጫ ወረቀቶች ቆጠራ እንዲቆም ለጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት አቤቱታ አቅርበዋል። መንግስት እነዚህ መራጮች የዜግነት መብት የላቸውም ሲል ሲከራከር፣ የካሊፎርኒያ ባለስልጣናት ግን የቀረበው መረጃ አስተማማኝ አለመሆኑን እና ብዙ ብቁ መራጮችን ሊጎዳ እንደሚችል ገልጸዋል። የታችኛው ፍርድ ቤቶች ጥያቄውን ውድቅ ያደረጉት ሲሆን፣ በዚህ ሰዓት የተጠረጠሩትን ድምፆች ለይቶ ማውጣት አዳጋች መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Traamp Kaliforniyaa keessatti sagalee poostaan ergame 20,000 ol ta'u kanneen lammii biyyaa miti jedhaman akka hin lakkaa'amne Mana Murtii Olaanaatti iyyataniiru. Mootummaan shakkii kana kaasu, aanga'oonni Kaliforniyaa garuu ragaan dhiyaate kan hin amanamneefi lammiilee biyyaa sirrii ta'an hedduu mirga isaanii kan sarbuudha jedhu. Mana murtiiwwan gadii iyyata kana kan dide yoo ta'u, yeroo ammaa kanatti sagalee shakkaman kana adda baasuun tasuma akka hin danda'amne ibsaniiru.

title: How a Democrat in Michigan rocked the party days before the US midterms
english: Democratic Congresswoman Haley Stevens caused a major stir in Michigan by publicly supporting Mike Rogers, her Republican opponent in the US Senate race. This unexpected move surprised many, as she chose to endorse a member of the opposing party rather than her fellow Democrat, Abdul El-Sayed. The incident has created significant tension within the party just days before the midterm elections.
amharic: የዲሞክራቲክ ፓርቲዋ የምክር ቤት አባል ሄይሊ ስቲቨንስ በሚቺጋን ግዛት ለሚካሄደው የአሜሪካ ሴኔት ምርጫ የሪፐብሊካኑን እጩ ማይክ ሮጀርስን በይፋ በመደገፍ ፓርቲያቸው ውስጥ መነጋገሪያ ሆነዋል። ይህ ድርጊት የራሳቸውን ፓርቲ እጩ አብዱል ኤል-ሳየድን ትተው ተቃዋሚውን ፓርቲ መደገፏ ብዙዎችን አስገርሟል። ይህ ክስተት በምርጫው ዋዜማ በዲሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ አባላት መካከል ከፍተኛ ውዝግብ ፈጥሯል።
oromo: miseensi mana maree biyyoolessa kan dimookraatappii Haley Stevens, naannoo Miishiganitti dorgommii senetii US irratti nama paartii morkataa kan ta'e Mike Rogers deggeruun isaanii yaada adda addaa uumeera. Gochi kun namoota hedduu kan ajaa'ibe yoo ta'u, isaanis ofii isaanii bakka bu'aa paartii dimookraatappii ta'anii osoo jiranii, nama paartii morkataa kan ta'e Abdul El-Sayeditti cehuun deggeruun isaanii shakkii guddaa uumeera. Taateen kun guyyoota muraasa filannoon duraa kun itti hafe kana keessa, miseensota paartichaa gidduutti wal dhabdee uumee jira.

title: Trump makes final campaign push in final weekend before election
english: In the final days before the midterm elections, Donald Trump traveled to states like Florida, Iowa, and Kansas to rally support and protect the Republican majority in Congress. He used these events to criticize Democratic policies while attempting to distract voters from widespread concerns regarding the rising cost of living. These rallies highlight a competitive political climate, as Democrats appear poised to potentially gain enough power to challenge the president's agenda.
amharic: በምርጫው ዋዜማ የቀድሞው ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በኮንግረስ ውስጥ የሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲን የበላይነት ለማስጠበቅ ወደ ፍሎሪዳ፣ አዮዋ እና ካንሳስ በመጓዝ የድጋፍ ሰልፎችን አካሂደዋል። ትራምፕ በዚህ የቅስቀሳ ጉዞአቸው በዲሞክራቶች ላይ የከረረ ትችት በመሰንዘር፣ የኑሮ ውድነትን በተመለከተ በህዝቡ ዘንድ ያለውን ስጋት ለመቀነስ ጥረት አድርገዋል። ዲሞክራቶች በምርጫው የኮንግረስን መቆጣጠሪያ ቦታዎች የማሸነፍ ዕድል ስላላቸው፣ ይህ የምርጫ ውድድር ለፕሬዚዳንቱ አስተዳደር ወሳኝ ሆኗል።
oromo: Guyyoota muraasa filannoo gidu-galeessaa dura, Donald Trump to'annoo paarlamoo isaanii eeggachuuf jecha gara Florida, Iowa fi Kansas imaluun deeggarsa gaafatan. Trump duula kana fayyadamuun imaammata Diimokraatotaa irratti duuluu fi yaaddoo ummataa kan gatiin jireenyaa itti hammaate sanas xiyyeeffannoo keessaa baasuuf yaalii godhan. Diimokraatonni bakka bu'oota hedduu akka argatan waan eegamuuf, bu'aan filannoo kanaa hojii aangoo prezidaantichaa irratti dhiibbaa guddaa qabaachuu danda'a.

title: Nine killed as small jet crashes on Florida street
english: A private business jet crashed onto a residential street in Florida on Sunday, resulting in the deaths of all nine people on board. The aircraft was traveling from Texas to the Bahamas when the crew reported severe technical difficulties, including icing issues and a rapid descent, shortly before the impact. Fortunately, there were no reported casualties or injuries among people on the ground despite the fiery nature of the crash.
amharic: እሁድ ዕለት በፍሎሪዳ ውስጥ አንድ የግል የንግድ አውሮፕላን በመኖሪያ መንገዶች ላይ በመከስከሱ በውስጡ የነበሩ ዘጠኝ ሰዎች በሙሉ ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። አውሮፕላኑ ከቴክሳስ ወደ ባሃማስ በመጓዝ ላይ እያለ የበረራ ሰራተኞቹ በረዶን ከመቆጣጠር ጋር የተያያዘ ችግርና ፈጣን ውድቀት እንደገጠማቸው በሬዲዮ ገልጸው ነበር። ምንም እንኳን አደጋው በከፍተኛ ፍንዳታ የታጀበ ቢሆንም፣ በምድር ላይ የነበሩ ሰዎች ምንም ጉዳት ሳይደርስባቸው መትረፋቸው ተገልጿል።
oromo: Dilbata darbe jiyeetii dhuunfaa tokko naannoo mana jireenyaa Florida keessatti kufuunsa isaan irraa kan ka'e namoonni sagal keessa turan hundi du'aniiru. Xiyyaarri kun Texas irraa gara Bahamas imalaa utuu jiruu, hojjettoonni isaa rakkoo cabbii fi xiyyaarichi dafee gadi bu'uu isaa gabaasanii turan. Balaan kun ibidda guddaa kan uume ta'us, namoonni lafa irra turan miidhaan tokko illee irra hin geenye.

title: Binance users withdraw $3.6bn after largest-ever crypto hack
english: Following the largest cryptocurrency hack in history, which resulted in the theft of $6.3 billion, Binance users withdrew $3.6 billion in assets as the platform resumed operations. The FBI has linked the massive cyber-attack to North Korean hackers, though Binance has committed to covering all losses and has already restored 95% of the stolen funds. While transaction withdrawals have stabilized, officials note that the stolen money is still being actively laundered through complex digital pathways.
amharic: በታሪክ ትልቁ የተባለውን የሳይበር ጥቃት ተከትሎ 6.3 ቢሊዮን ዶላር የሚገመት የዲጂታል ገንዘብ ከተሰረቀ በኋላ፣ ባይናንስ አገልግሎቱን ሲመልስ ደንበኞቹ 3.6 ቢሊዮን ዶላር አውጥተዋል። የኤፍቢአይ ምርመራ የሳይበር ጥቃቱን ከሰሜን ኮሪያ ጠላፊዎች ጋር የሚያያይዘው ሲሆን፣ ባይናንስ የጠፋውን ገንዘብ ሙሉ በሙሉ እንደሚተካ ቃል ገብቶ ከ95 በመቶ በላይ የሚሆነውን ገንዘብ መመለሱን አስታውቋል። ምንም እንኳን የገንዘብ ማውጣቱ ሂደት አሁን ላይ የተረጋጋ ቢሆንም፣ የተሰረቀው ገንዘብ በተለያዩ መንገዶች በህገ-ወጥ መንገድ የመቀየር ስራ እየተከናወነ መሆኑ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Hakkii guddaa seenaa keessatti raawwatamee fi qarshii biiliyoona 6.3 hatamee booda, Binance hojii isaa yeroo deebisutti fayyadamtoonni isaa biiliyoona 3.6 baafataniiru. FBI qorannoo isaatiin miidhaa kana duubatti garee haakeroota Kooriyaa Kaabaa akka jiran kan ibse yoo ta'u, Binance garuu miidhaa gahe hunda akka deebisu waadaa galee hanga ammaatti 95% deebisuu isaa beeksiseera. Sochiin maallaqa baafachuu yeroo ammaa tasgabbaa'us, maallaqni hatame sun karaa walxaxaa ta'een seeraan ala gara bakka biraatti jijjiiramaa akka jiru ogeeyyiin ni ibsu.

title: Ryanair says it may freeze workers' pay and raise airfares
english: Ryanair is considering freezing employee wages and increasing ticket prices to offset significant losses caused by soaring aviation fuel costs. These costs have spiked due to the ongoing conflict in the Middle East, negatively impacting the airline's recent profits. To manage the financial strain, the company plans to raise airfares significantly and potentially pause future salary increases for its staff.
amharic: ራያን ኤር (Ryanair) በነዳጅ ዋጋ መጨመር ምክንያት ያጋጠመውን የገንዘብ ኪሳራ ለመሸፈን የሰራተኞችን ደሞዝ ላለመጨመር እና የአውሮፕላን ትኬት ዋጋን ለመጨመር እያሰበ ነው። በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ያለው ግጭት ለነዳጅ ዋጋ ንረት ዋና ምክንያት በመሆኑ የኩባንያውን ትርፍ ቀንሶታል። ይህንን የገንዘብ ችግር ለመቋቋም አየር መንገዱ የትኬት ዋጋን ከፍ ከማድረጉም በላይ፣ የሰራተኞች የደሞዝ ጭማሪን ለጊዜው ለማቆም እቅድ ይዟል።
oromo: Ryanair baasii boba'aa dabaleen walqabatee miidhaa maallaqaa isa mudate qolachuuf jecha, mindaa hojjetootaa gadi qabuu fi gatii tikkeettii xiyyaaraa dabaluuf karoorfateera. Waraana giddu galeessa bahaa jiruun walqabatee gatiin boba'aa waan dabaleef, bu'aan qaban hir'ateera. Rakkoo maallaqaa kana furuuf, dhaabbatichi gatii imalaa dabaluu fi mindaa hojjetootaa yeroodhaaf akka hin daballe yaadaa jira.

title: Sudan files complaints against Ethiopia with UN over deadly drone spree
english: The Sudanese government has submitted formal complaints to the UN and African Union, alleging that Ethiopia is allowing the Rapid Support Forces to use its territory to launch lethal drone attacks. According to Khartoum, these strikes have killed or injured hundreds of civilians and damaged critical infrastructure since February. Sudan claims these drone operations originate from multiple Ethiopian locations, further escalating the tensions between the two nations amid their ongoing civil conflict.
amharic: የሱዳን መንግሥት የራፒድ ሰፖርት ፎርሰስ (RSF) የኢትዮጵያን ግዛት በመጠቀም ገዳይ የድሮን ጥቃቶችን እየፈጸመ ነው በሚል ለተባበሩት መንግሥታት ድርጅትና ለአፍሪካ ኅብረት አቤቱታ አቅርቧል። ካርቱም ከየካቲት ወር ጀምሮ በተፈጸሙት ጥቃቶች በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ንጹሃን ዜጎች መገደላቸውንና መቁሰላቸውን እንዲሁም ወሳኝ መሠረተ ልማቶች መውደማቸውን አስታውቃለች። ሱዳን እነዚህ ጥቃቶች የኢትዮጵያ ግዛት ከሆኑ አካባቢዎች የሚነሱ መሆናቸውን በመግለጽ ጉዳዩ በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ያለውን የዲፕሎማሲ ውጥረት አባብሶታል።
oromo: Mootummaan Sudaan gareen RSF jedhamu biyya Itoophiyaa fayyadamuun weerara doonii du'a fidu raawwachaa jira jechuun gara Gamtaa Afrikaa fi Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomaniitti komii dhiyeesseera. Kaartuum akka ibsiteetti, weerarri doonii Bitootessa darbe irraa eegalee raawwatamee ture namoota nagaa hedduu ajjeesuu fi miidhuu akkasumas bu'uuraalee misoomaa hedduu barbadeessuu isaa ibsiteetti. Sudaan weerarri kunneen naannoolee Itoophiyaa garaa garaa irraa karoorfamaa akka jiru himuun, kunis hariiroo biyyoota lamaanii fi waraana keessoo isaa irratti dhiibbaa uumuu isaa ibsiteetti.

title: Jailed PKK founder Ocalan moved to new section of Turkish island prison
english: Turkish authorities have transferred Abdullah Ocalan, the imprisoned leader of the PKK, to a new facility on Imrali island after 27 years of detention. Pro-Kurdish politicians are calling this move an opportunity to revitalize the stalled peace process between the government and Kurdish groups. While the transfer is seen by some as a step toward involving Ocalan more directly in negotiations, others argue that his living conditions remain unchanged.
amharic: የቱርክ ባለስልጣናት ለ27 ዓመታት በእስር ላይ የቆዩትን የፒኬኬ መስራች አብዱላህ ኦጃላንን በኢምራሊ ደሴት ወደሚገኝ አዲስ የተገነባ እስር ቤት አዛውረዋል። የኩርድ ደጋፊ ፖለቲከኞች ይህ እርምጃ በመንግስት እና በኩርድ ቡድኖች መካከል የቆመውን የሰላም ሂደት እንደገና ለማነቃቃት እድል እንደሚሰጥ ገልጸዋል። ምንም እንኳን ይህ ዝውውር ኦጃላን በድርድሩ ውስጥ የበለጠ ተሳትፎ እንዲኖረው ለማድረግ ያለመ ነው ቢባልም፣ አንዳንድ ወገኖች ግን የኑሮ ሁኔታው እንደማይለወጥ ይከራከራሉ።
oromo: Mootummaan Turkiis hoggansa garee PKK kan ta'an Abdullah Ocalan, waggoota 27f bakka itti hidhamanii turan Imrali irraa gara mana hidhaa haaraa ijaarameetti jijjiireera. Paartileen siyaasaa warra Kuurdii deeggaran, tarkaanfiin kun marii nagaa mootummaa fi garee Kuurdii gidduutti lafa qabachuu dide akka deebi'ee haqaarsuuf carraa gaarii akka ta'e dubbatu. Jijjiirraan kun Ocalan marii nagaa keessatti qooda caalu akka qabaatuuf kan karoorfame ta'us, gareen tokko tokko haalli jireenyaa isaa kan hin jijjiiramne ta'uu ibsanii jiru.

title: As aid situation worsens, displaced Sudanese worry about warnings of famine
english: The ongoing conflict in Sudan between the army and paramilitary forces has triggered a catastrophic humanitarian crisis, displacing 13 million people and causing widespread famine. Many families, including those in displacement camps near Port Sudan, are suffering as international aid supplies continue to dwindle. With food shortages worsening, displaced individuals are struggling to survive and facing an uncertain future as officials warn of an imminent famine.
amharic: በሱዳን በመንግስት ጦር እና በፈጥኖ ደራሽ ኃይሉ መካከል እየተካሄደ ያለው ጦርነት አስከፊ ሰብአዊ ቀውስ በመፍጠሩ 13 ሚሊዮን ዜጎች ተፈናቅለዋል፣ አገሪቱም ለከፍተኛ ረሃብ ተጋልጣለች። በፖርት ሱዳን አካባቢ የሚገኙ ተፈናቃዮችን ጨምሮ በርካታ ቤተሰቦች እየቀነሰ በመጣው ዓለም አቀፍ እርዳታ ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ችግር ላይ ናቸው። የምግብ አቅርቦት እጥረት እየተባባሰ በመምጣቱ እና የረሃብ ስጋት በመደቀኑ ተፈናቃዮች ለህልውናቸው እየታገሉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Waraanni biyya Sudaan keessatti humni waraana biyyaatii fi gareen finxaaleyyii gidduutti geggeeffamaa jiru balaa namoomaa cimaa kan hordofsiise yoo ta'u, namoonni miliyoona 13 ta'an buqqa'anii beela hamaaf saaxilamaniiru. Mana jireenyaa irraa kan buqqa'an fi magaala Port Sudaanitti kan argaman dabalatee, maatiin hedduun gargaarsi namoomaa waan hir'ateef rakkina hamaa keessa jiru. Hanqinni nyaataa guyyuu dabalaa waan dhufeef fi akeekkachiisni beelaa waan jiruuf, namoonni buqqa'an jiraachuuf qabsoo cimaa gochaa jiru.

title: ‘Just the beginning’ for Antonelli, F1’s prodigious, charismatic new king
english: Kimi Antonelli has made history as the youngest-ever Formula One world champion at the age of 20 after securing a podium finish in Mexico City. The Italian driver is being celebrated as a generational talent, having been mentored by experienced professionals and supported by his racing-enthusiast father. Antonelli expressed that this title is only the start of his career as he looks forward to competing against legendary drivers like Max Verstappen and Lewis Hamilton in the future.
amharic: ኪሚ አንቶኔሊ በ20 ዓመቱ የሜክሲኮ ሲቲ ግራንድ ፕሪክስን በማሸነፍ በፎርሙላ ዋን ታሪክ ትንሹ የዓለም ሻምፒዮን መሆን ችሏል። ጣሊያናዊው ወጣት ተወዳዳሪ እንደ ብርቅዬ ተሰጥኦ እየታየ ሲሆን፣ ስኬቱም ከልጅነቱ ጀምሮ ከነበረው የውድድር ፍቅር የመነጨ ነው። አንቶኔሊ ይህ ድል ለወደፊት የሙያ ዘመኑ መጀመሪያ ብቻ እንደሆነ በመግለጽ፣ ከታላላቅ የዘርፉ ተወዳዳሪዎች ጋር በመጪዎቹ ጊዜያት የበለጠ ለመወዳደር ዝግጁ መሆኑን ተናግሯል።
oromo: ኪሚ አንቶኔሊ ዕድሜው 20 ዓመት ብቻ ሆኖ ሳለ፣ በሜክሲኮ ሲቲ ግራንድ ፕሪክስ በማሸነፍ በፎርሙላ ዋን ታሪክ ትንሹ የዓለም ሻምፒዮን በመሆን ታሪክ ሰርቷል። የጣሊያን ተወላጁ አንቶኔሊ እንደ ልዩ ተሰጥኦ የሚታይ ሲሆን፣ ይህ ስኬት ከልጅነቱ ጀምሮ በነበረው የውድድር ፍቅር የመጣ ነው። አንቶኔሊ ይህ ዋንጫ ለወደፊት የውድድር ዘመኑ መጀመሪያ ብቻ እንደሆነ በመናገር፣ ወደፊት እንደ ማክስ ቨርስታፔን እና ሉዊስ ሃሚልተን ካሉ ታላላቅ ተወዳዳሪዎች ጋር ለመፎካከር ዝግጁ መሆኑን ገልጿል።

title: Saudi-led coalition intercepts a missile as fighting rages in Yemen’s al-Jawf
english: The Saudi-led coalition successfully intercepted a ballistic missile and a drone aimed at southern Saudi Arabia amid ongoing conflict in Yemen. Meanwhile, intense fighting continues in the al-Jawf province as government forces claim significant operations against Houthi fighters. Additionally, Houthi-linked media reported that coalition airstrikes in Hodeidah left seven people wounded.
amharic: በየመን ግጭት እየተባባሰ ባለበት ወቅት የሳውዲ ጥምረት ወደ ሳውዲ አረቢያ የተተኮሰ ባለስቲክ ሚሳይል እና ድሮን ማክሸፉን አስታውቋል። በአል-ጃውፍ ግዛት በመንግስት ወታደሮች እና በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች መካከል ከፍተኛ ውጊያ እየተካሄደ ሲሆን መንግስት በታጣቂዎቹ ላይ መጠነ ሰፊ እርምጃ እንደወሰደ ገልጿል። በሌላ በኩል በሁቲዎች ቁጥጥር ስር ባሉ መገናኛ ብዙሃን እንደተዘገበው በሆዴዳ በተካሄደ የአየር ጥቃት ሰባት ሰዎች መቁሰላቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Waraanni Yemen keessatti hammaachaa jirutti, gamtaan Saudii durfamu xiyyara gadi-lakkiftuu fi xiyyara nama hin feene gara Saudii biyyattiitti ergame rukutee kuffiseera. Gama biraatiin, naannoo al-Jawf keessatti waraanni mootummaa fi loltoonni Huutii giddutti walitti bu’iinsi cimaan kan jiru yoo ta’u, mootummaan tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuu isaa beeksiseera. Kana malees, miidiyaaleen Huutii akka gabaasanitti, duula qilleensaa gamtichi Hodeidah keessatti gaggeesseen namoonni torba madaawaniiru.

title: Ethiopia’s WTO Terms Harden as Members Ask for More
english: Ethiopia is preparing for a crucial meeting regarding its membership bid to the World Trade Organization scheduled for November 2026. Although negotiators failed to meet their initial goal for completing the accession process earlier this year, the country is still pushing forward with its efforts. The government continues to manage the reform process independently as it works toward becoming a full member of the global trade body.
amharic: ኢትዮጵያ በኖቬምበር 2026 ለሚካሄደው የዓለም የንግድ ድርጅት አባልነት ድርድር ዝግጅቷን እያደረገች ነው። ቀደም ሲል በያዝነው ዓመት መጀመሪያ ላይ የተቀመጠው የጊዜ ገደብ ባይሳካም፣ ድርድሩ አሁንም መቀጠሉ ተገልጿል። መንግሥት በድርጅቱ ውስጥ አባል ለመሆን የሚያስፈልጉትን ማሻሻያዎች በማድረግ ሂደት ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Itoophiyaan miseensa Dhaabbata Daldalaa Addunyaa ta'uuf carraaqqii gootu cimsitee itti fufteetti. Haata'u malee, mariin kanaan dura ture galii gaarii waan hin argatinneef, mariin idilee ittaanu kan qabamee jiru Hagayya 2026 keessa. Mootummaan biyyattii miseensa ta'uuf jijjiiramoota barbaachisan hojiirra oolchuudhaan adeemsa isaa hordofaa jira.

title: France launches attempted murder investigation after petrol bomb thrown at police
english: French authorities have opened an attempted murder investigation after a police officer was set on fire by a petrol bomb during recent protests in Paris. The incident occurred amidst widespread demonstrations regarding the high cost of living and insufficient public services. While hundreds of protesters were arrested across the country, police are still searching for the individuals responsible for the violent attack on the officer.
amharic: ፈረንሳይ በፓሪስ በተካሄደ ተቃውሞ ወቅት በፖሊስ ላይ በተወረወረ የፔትሮል ቦምብ አንድ የፖሊስ አባል በእሳት በመቃጠሉ የነፍስ ማጥፋት ሙከራ ምርመራ ከፍታለች። ይህ ጥቃት የተፈጸመው ስለኑሮ ውድነት እና ስለመንግስት አገልግሎቶች መሻሻል በሚጠይቁ ሰፊ ህዝባዊ ሰልፎች መካከል ነው። በሀገሪቱ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ተቃዋሚዎች በቁጥጥር ስር የዋሉ ሲሆን፣ ባለስልጣናት በፖሊስ አባሉ ላይ ጥቃት ያደረሱትን ሰዎች አሁንም እያደኑ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Faransaayi keessatti, hiriira mormii Paarisirratti poolisii tokkorratti gombii boba’aa darbameen qaamni isaa gubachuu hordofee, qaamni seeraa shakkamtota irratti qorannoo yaalii ajjeechaa banera. Miidhaan kun kan mudate yeroo namoonni baay’een gatii jireenyaa fi tajaajila hawaasaa fooyyessuuf hiriira ba’anitti dha. Biyattii keessatti hiriirtonni hedduun to’annoo jala oolanis, qaamni seeraa namoota poolisicha irratti haleellaa raawwatan barbaacha irra jira.

title: El-Sayed dismisses Stevens’ backing of Republican Senate candidate
english: Abdul El-Sayed has criticized fellow Democrat Haley Stevens for her decision to endorse a Republican opponent in an upcoming race.
